batch_unit: foot ROI (two per matched person-image sample)
scope: All eligible train images/targets, all internal validation; frozen GUSH3R; train Stage-A contact head, no geometry-error sample filter
input: Frozen all-person prediction; 5x5 wide local DINO patches plus 4x4 global context, pose/query, physical K, and masked predicted point-map neighborhoods
matching: Mutually unique predicted head inside 5%-padded GT body bbox; GT only labels/detection association, never predictor inputs
validation: Full ParkingLot2 internal validation each epoch; report matched metrics, missed targets as negative predictions, coverage, and all-positive baseline
